The '''Tuerto system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tuerto]].
